spec.description: Time-series view of block storage provisioned and actually used, per cluster, product, project and namespace.

spec.expr:
sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  sum by (cluster, namespace) (${agg}_over_time(pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__interval]))
)

sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  sum by (cluster, namespace) (${agg}_over_time(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__interval]))
)

label_replace(
  sum by (label_product) (
    clamp_max(
      topk(1,
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
        or
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
      ) by (cluster, namespace)
      , 1)
    * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
    sum by (cluster, namespace) (${agg}_over_time(pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__interval]))
  ),
  "label_product", "(none)", "label_product", "^$"
)

label_replace(
  sum by (label_product) (
    clamp_max(
      topk(1,
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
        or
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
      ) by (cluster, namespace)
      , 1)
    * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
    sum by (cluster, namespace) (${agg}_over_time(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__interval]))
  ),
  "label_product", "(none)", "label_product", "^$"
)
